commented_code:
+# Removes old build-only tags from the container registry.
+#
+# docker.yml tags every build of `main` as `sha-<commit>`, and nothing removed them. This
+# deletes image versions that carry only such build tags once they are 30 days old.
+# Releases, `latest`, `main`, the `major.minor` aliases and the live build caches are
+# never candidates. A `sha-*` tag that shares its image with a release also stays,
+# because GitHub can only delete a whole image version.
+#
+# A pull request that touches this workflow or its script gets a dry run with a read-only
+# token. A manual run is a dry run unless `delete` is ticked, and it only deletes when it
+# is run from the default branch.
+
+name: Prune Docker image tags
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    # 09:00 UTC on the first day of each month.
+    - cron: '0 9 1 * *'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      delete:
+        description: 'Delete the listed versions (leave off for a dry run)'
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+      tags:
+        description: 'Extra exact tags to treat as disposable, comma-separated'
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+  pull_request:
+    branches:
+      - main
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/docker-prune.yml'
+      - 'scripts/pruneDockerImages.mjs'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: docker-prune-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || 'registry' }}
+  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+
+env:
+  RETENTION_DAYS: '30'
+  EXTRA_TAGS: ${{ inputs.tags || '' }}
+
+jobs:
+  plan:
+    name: List prunable versions
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 10
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      packages: read
+    steps:
+      - &checkout
+        name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: List the versions that would be removed
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

discussion_comments.comment_body: Addressed by revalidating instead of sharing a concurrency group, since the publisher no longer has a single group to share (#11688 keys it per release). The script now reads each version again right before its delete and leaves it alone if its tags differ from the ones it was planned with; its attestation stays too. A test changes a version's tags between the listing and the delete and checks that no delete is sent for it.

discussion_comments.comment_body: `github.event.head_commit.message` is user-controlled for a normal push (for example, the squash title of a merged PR). Any ordinary main commit whose title starts with `chore(main): release ` makes this condition false, so neither architecture runs here. On that path `release-please.yml` invokes this reusable workflow only when `release_created == true`, so a non-release commit with that prefix gets no replacement image test or publish. Restrict this bypass to a verifiable release-please commit form (or use a release-created signal), and add a negative prefix-only push case to the expression test.
